bug_semantics: The MISP Modules Flask website enabled Flask-WTF CSRFProtect globally, then exempted the entire home blueprint. After that exemption, authenticated home routes accepted GET/POST without a CSRF token, including home() which wrote request query data into the Flask session (request.args via ast.literal_eval; request.form via json.loads). A cross-site request could therefore mutate session query state in the victim's authenticated context. The 2026-04-29 patch removed csrf.exempt(home_blueprint) and replaced ast.literal_eval with json.loads.
flaw_origin: On 2024-05-16, commit 1457575dda5a846a702199bc02f6d516f8cd0627 ('new: [functionality] flowintel + multiple entry') added csrf.exempt(home_blueprint) in website/app/__init__.py, converted home() to methods=['GET','POST'], and first wrote sess['query'] = ast.literal_eval(request.args.get('query')). The parent already had csrf.init_app(app) and a GET-only home() that only passed query into the template. Later c23b60e1ba4fa5f7bd3d10567ba4eba947c7c9a9 (Poetry/arch refactor) preserved the exemption and parser unchanged and is not the BIC.
